title: Find the worst PSD residual without assuming a fixed sign
statement: For A=D^-1+Sstar SPD, min_(E>=0,diagE<=rho) 1T(A+E)^-1 1 = max_x[2 1Tx-xTAx-(sum sqrt(rho_i)|x_i|)^2]. E=rrT is worst-case if (A+rrT)^-1 1>=0 componentwise. Without this guard the two-control source has true rank-two minimum1/30, below3/85 and1/29.

body: Compact PSD diagonal envelopes and uniform coercivity justify minimax. The support function is attained by a signed rank-one matrix for a fixed x, but that does not make a hardcoded completion optimal. The exact counterexample uses D=.1I,Sstar=[[10,30],[30,90]],rho=(10,10), E=10I and dual x=(1/30,0). Use the sign-independent tangent lower bound F(A)-(sum sqrt(rho)|A^-1 1|)^2 or a certified convex solve when the sign test fails.
